noise.title: Noise / rules and changing bodies
noise.label: NOISE / TWO FLOORS
noise.notice:
Carry the framed point; compare admitted neighbours. Listen to the two noise sculptures.
Walk around the three viewing walls. Shaft A leads to the column comparison.
Floor 2: FREEZE, REVEAL, SPIN and MARBLE. R / B retries your current floor.

array_tutorial.title: Arrays / an address survives an absence
array_tutorial.label: ARRAY / ADDRESSED SUPPORT
array_tutorial.notice:
32 addresses; a 7 x 7 grid; shaft B: hand-controlled indices.
Shaft A: 6 x 6 x 6 pickups. Fly inside the box; gravity outside.
Desktop: look + WASD, Space up, Ctrl down. VR: aim left hand + left stick.

color.title: Colour / a celebration of 23 columns
color.label: COLOUR / A CELEBRATION
color.notice:
23 original columns: colour rules, shape families, twists, tapers and gallery compositions.
On the first four: RULE changes the assignment; PART + selects; PAINT recolours one part.
Desktop: aim and click. VR: point and trigger. RESET restores; R / B retries.

color_flashlight.title: Colour / Flashlight
color_flashlight.label: COLOUR / LIGHT CHANGES COLOUR
color_flashlight.notice:
Four coloured lamps: carry, aim, release. Walk into the changing white room and sky opening.
Five switches: combine pink lights; compare LIGHT / MATERIAL.
Desktop: right-click carry/drop, left-click switches. VR: grip carry, trigger switches.

tiling.title: Tiling / same floor, another palette
tiling.label: TILING / PATTERN DISCO
tiling.notice:
HOLD the floor, then change COLOUR. ONE STEP changes values instead.
Walk across the moving pattern: the support stays still.
The sequencer has its own PLAY and STOP. Click on desktop; point and trigger in VR.

forces.title: Vectors & Forces / vectors in your hands
forces.label: VECTORS / TWO POINTS MAKE A RELATION
forces.notice:
Move the black points: length and direction, then addition, then signed projection.
Right-click to carry/drop on desktop; grip in VR. RESET restores each station.
These arrows describe a relation. They do not yet apply a force.

formfinding.title: Form Finding / Where Does Downhill Take You?
formfinding.label: FORM FINDING / ONE LOCAL STEP
formfinding.notice:
Predict the gold point's next position, then press STEP. Compare START and SURFACE.
RATE changes the step; STOP changes the tolerance. PARTS and RULE reveal the calculation.
Click on desktop; point and trigger in VR. R / B retries the floor.

wavefunctions.title: Wave Functions / The cube comes back
wavefunctions.label: WAVE FUNCTIONS / WHAT RETURNS
wavefunctions.notice:
Watch the clock cube, then take the pendulum bob aside and release.
Same angle, opposite velocity: watch the ring count each crossing.
The blue cube and screen follow that pendulum. Right-click / VR grip to hold and release.

randomness.title: Randomness / seeds and different entropies
randomness.label: RANDOMNESS / TWO FLOORS
randomness.notice:
Touch a point. REPLAY repeats its kept path. The cabinet compares the same seed with another draw or colour mapping.
Grip / right-click carries the black return point. Descend through shaft A to the chair studies.
Floor 2: compare colour draws, arrangements, recipes, door histories, heat and guesses. R / B retries your current floor.

shaders.title: Shaders / transfer study
shaders.label: SHADERS / TRANSFER
shaders.notice:
Two original museum collections. Floor 1: shaping desks and shared wall/cube mask. Floor 2: pattern rooms, camera and fuzzy studies.
Use the original knobs and buttons. Shaft A connects the floors; R / B retries the current floor. Arrangement is editable; curation follows.

cellularautomata.title: Cellular Automata / transfer study
cellularautomata.label: CELLULAR AUTOMATA / TRANSFER
cellularautomata.notice:
Two original museum collections. Floor 1: neighbours, weaving, swarms and rule histories. Floor 2: active, fading and empty cells.
Move the black point to inspect a cell; STEP advances its rule. Shaft A connects the floors; R / B retries. Arrange first, curate next.

fractals.title: Fractals / transfer study
fractals.label: FRACTALS / TRANSFER
fractals.notice:

Use the original desks and controls. Shaft A connects the floors; R / B retries. Arrange first, curate next.
